title: Independent reproduction of Cu2In2Te2 cluster structure and electronic properties
difficulty_reasons: The agent must discover and discriminate multiple neutral and anionic cluster geometries before calculating properties.
The anion charge state and method sensitivity require explicit validation and limitation reporting.

paper.title: Structural evolution and stabilities of (CuIn)nTe2 and ((CuIn)nTe2)− (n = 1–8) clusters via DFT study

data.description: Fixed six-atom Cu2In2Te2 composition, charge states 0 and -1, multiplicity and isolated-vacuum boundary.

required_deliverables.description: Validated candidate structures, energies, observables, method metadata, evidence and conclusion.
